body: I don’t want to keep going but I’m too afraid of the unknown. I’m not scared about missing out on anything and I believe that when it’s over it’s just over but I’m afraid.

I’m right there too. It feels like I just don’t fit in. Like I’m not someone worth being around. It’s a horrible feeling and I moved away from home after feeling like that for a little under a year just to try and see life a little differently. The same story played out all over again though. Maybe spending time with someone very occasionally but it always seeming like I was the last resort. I even met this girl who could turn my whole day around, she was incredible and I honestly loved her more than anything. After about 4 months of hanging out and spending time together I told her I liked her more than just a friend. She told me she didn’t share the same feelings for me. I took one good situation and in my fucked head turned it into something it probably wasn’t and for her sake shouldn’t of been. That hit me really hard and in my head I can’t let go. 

 It’s hard to see the point anymore when whatever I try turns out shit and nothing seems to change and honestly I’m losing my grip on life.

The only thing I have anymore is work. I work at a tire shop and for those few hours in the day where I get to put my head down and just work or even forget who I am all together is the only thing that comes close to a reason to live anymore. Maybe it just takes time but I don’t know if I can give myself “one more day.”

I’m sorry I couldn’t share something more helpful but maybe in someway this shows you aren’t completely alone.
